description: Find top sourcing-pick ASINs across the entire catalog with optional filters: max retail price, min retail price, category, brand, exclude gated, exclude Amazon private label. Use when the user asks 'top sourcing picks', 'best ASINs to source', 'ASINs under $X with rising demand', 'fastest growing ASINs', or any cross-cutting question where they have NOT named a specific entity yet. Each pick carries product brand, title and price (or price range) plus fulfillment (FBA/FBM/Amazon) alongside the sourcing scores.

limit.description: Number of products to return (default 10, max 50).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_velocity_score.description: Minimum velocity sub-score (0-100). >=90 = 'rising demand' (top ~3%%), >=70 = 'moderate growth' (top ~10%%). >=50 covers 97%% of ASINs and is not a meaningful filter.

product_title_contains.description: Keyword title search across the WHOLE catalog (FULLTEXT, token-AND any order — may also match the product description), ranked by sourcing score. Broader recall than a literal substring: 'ceiling fan mount' matches titles containing all three words in any order.

scope.description: tracked = only ASINs from brands on the user's watchlist; universe = all. Default universe.

name: top_sourcing_picks
